visual_text: Illustrative example, not a real patient
A function score can record any one of the three. Ask which.
Yes, I can make a hot drink.
Test What the person does in a test, with a therapist watching.
At home What the person does at home on an ordinary day.
Glass, Gerontologist 1998; Bandeen-Roche et al., BMC Geriatr 2023
alt_text: Three-panel illustrative strip of one imagined older man and one task, making a hot drink. Says: he tells a nurse he can do it. Test: he fills a kettle with a therapist watching. At home: he does it with no one watching. A function score can record any one of the three.
design_instructions: Three stacked comic panels (strip.p3), same older man with white beard and cardigan: seated with nurse and a speech bubble, filling a kettle with OT watching, filling a kettle at home. Captions with bold labels. No numbers. Illustrative kicker.
